title: Questions
description: What an executor wrote to outbox/questions.json when it stopped for input (exit 2). The answer side (.loom/answers/<task>.json) is control-plane internal and has no schema.

id.description: Q1, Q2, ... unique within the run; restarts every run, so answers pair by (question_id, run_id).

why_now.description: Why this blocks now rather than later.

blocking.description: True stops the task until answered; at most 3 per run.

recommended.description: Option id the executor recommends; must exist in options.

default.description: Option id to proceed with when the question is non-blocking; must exist in options.

evidence.description: Path/artifact references only, never full text.

ttl_s.description: Expiry; past it the default applies or the question blocks again.
